summary: Implemented and exported `Perc`, with orientation-aware grouped percentile rows, missing-value exclusion, NumPy method compatibility before and after 1.22.0, API documentation, and a v0.12.1 release note. Added direct tests for defaults, counts, explicit levels, methods, grouping, orientation, imports, and `Plot.add`. The focused statistics suite passed (44 tests), and the new tests passed (6 tests); `git diff --check` passed. I did not run the full repository suite or build documentation.
